content: Rifabutin reduces the levels of levonorgestrel (oral) by inducing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of levonorgestrel/ethinyl estradiol/ferrous bisglycinate by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced; alternative or backup contraception should be used during enzyme inducer coadministration and for 28 days after discontinuation of the inducer. Rifabutin reduces linagliptin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and alternative treatments are strongly recommended when linagliptin is coadministered with a CYP3A4 inducer. Rifabutin decreases lofepramine levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces lomitapide levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Rifabutin decreases losartan levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces maprotiline levels by increasing its metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases medroxyprogesterone levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Contraceptive failure is possible; consider alternative methods if available. Rifabutin reduces mefloquine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases metoprolol levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. The enzyme induction effect may persist for 3–4 weeks. Rifabutin reduces mifepristone levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and coadministration with CYP3A4 inducers is not recommended by the manufacturer. Rifabutin decreases mirtazapine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Mitotane reduces rifabutin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Mitotane is a strong CYP3A4 inducer; monitor for potential dosage adjustments when coadministered with CYP3A4 substrates. Rifabutin reduces modafinil levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases montelukast levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Nafcillin reduces rifabutin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Nefazodone increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while rifabutin decreases nefazodone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces nevirapine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases nifedipine levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Rifabutin reduces nimodipine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Nirmatrelvir increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Monitor for rifabutin-related adverse effects, including neutropenia and uveitis. Ritonavir prescribing information recommends reducing rifabutin doses by at least 75% to 150 mg every other day or three times weekly when coadministered with ritonavir. Rifabutin decreases nitrenedipine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces norgestrel levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Moderate CYP3A4 inducers may decrease progestin concentrations; consider additional barrier methods. Rifabutin decreases nortriptyline levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces oliceridine levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. If coadministration with a CYP3A4 inducer is necessary, consider increasing the oliceridine dose until stable drug effects are achieved. Monitor for signs of opioid withdrawal. If the inducer is discontinued, consider reducing the oliceridine dosage and monitor for respiratory depression. Rifabutin decreases ondansetron levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces osilodrostat levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Adjust the osilodrostat dose if needed during coadministration or discontinuation with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin decreases ospemifene levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces oxybutynin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases oxycodone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces paclitaxel levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases parecoxib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces paricalcitol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases phenindione levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Phenobarbital reduces rifabutin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Rifabutin decreases pimavanserin levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration if possible. Monitor for reduced pimavanserin efficacy, and an increase in dosage may be required. Rifabutin reduces pimozide levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases pioglitazone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces pitolisant levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. If the strong CYP3A4 inducer is discontinued, reduce the pitolisant dosage by half. Rifabutin decreases polatuzumab vedotin levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces posaconazole levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases primaquine levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces propafenone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases propranolol levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces protamine levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases protriptyline levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces quazepam levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases quinine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces rabeprazole levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases raltegravir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces ramelteon levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases ribociclib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, while ribociclib increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifapentine reduces rifabutin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases riociguat levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Rifabutin reduces rivaroxaban levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rucaparib increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Rifabutin decreases saxagliptin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces sildenafil levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Rifabutin decreases sufentanil levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Rifabutin reduces suvorexant levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases tadalafil levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid combination in pulmonary hypertension patients. For erectile dysfunction patients, monitor response carefully. Rifabutin reduces tamoxifen levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases tamsulosin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces tasimelteon levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Tecovirimat reduces rifabutin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases teniposide levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces terbinafine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases tetracycline levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces tiagabine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases ticagrelor levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid use with potent CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin reduces tinidazole levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases tofacitinib levels and efficacy by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin reduces toremifene levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Rifabutin decreases tramadol levels and its active metabolite (O-desmethyltramadol) by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor.
